description.value: This study used high-resolution structural MRI and voxel-based morphometry to compare gray matter density in patients with frontotemporal dementia and healthy controls, testing whether the rostral limbic system is selectively affected.

spans.text: The aim of this study was to test the hypothesis that the rostral limbic system is selectively affected in FTD.

value: if the rostral limbic system is involved, atrophy should be confirmed in the anterior cingulate, ventromedial prefrontal, anterior insular cortices and amygdala, and found in the ventral striatum and periaqueductal gray, as components of the system suspected to be damaged

spans.text: The comparisons were carried out under the hypothesis that, if the rostral limbic system is involved, atrophy should be confirmed in the anterior cingulate, ventromedial prefrontal, anterior insular cortices and amygdala , and found in the ventral striatum and periaqueductal gray, as components of the system suspected to be damaged .
